mapper.select: SELECT id, knowledge_id, user_id, type, content, file_status, title, content_hash, embedding_status, chunk_count, last_embedded_at, last_error, metadata, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_documents WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT kd.id, NULL::integer AS chunk_index, NULL::double precision AS score, kd.title, NULL::text AS snippet, kd.metadata->>'docCategory' AS doc_category, CASE WHEN kd.user_id = #{userId} AND kd.type = 1 AND kd.file_status = 1 THEN '/knowledge-document/' || kd.id || '/download' ELSE NULL END AS download_path FROM knowledge_documents kd JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.id = kd.knowledge_id AND kb.user_id = kd.user_id WHERE ((kd.user_id = #{userId} AND kb.scope = 1) OR (kd.user_id = 0 AND kb.scope = 3)) AND kd.file_status != 3 AND kd.id IN #{id}
